parsing_traps: FACING-PAGE POSITIONAL SPLIT: The audited Portfolio Statement uses a split across pairs of physical pages (odd=description, even=values). The description table (property name/tenure/location) and the value table (gross revenue/occupancy/valuation) are in SEPARATE tables with blank col0 on the value side — confirmed llm_only shape.

MULTI-CURRENCY: All SGD valuations are the Group's consolidated SGD figures from the audited Portfolio Statement (p130-167). Per-country cards report in local currencies (AUD, RMB, HKD, INR, JPY, MYR, KRW, VND). The properties.json records currency per row reflecting the local-currency market for operational metrics but market_valuation is always in SGD as disclosed in the Group audited statement.

DIVESTED PROPERTIES WITH REVENUE: Some divested properties (e.g. Linfox, Celestica Hub, Zentraline — Malaysia; Toki/Aichi/Moriya — Japan; Xi'an — China) show partial-year gross revenue for FY24/25. They have null valuations at 31/03/2025. Divested prior-year properties (Kenyon, Pioneer Districentre, 73 Tuas South Ave 1, Chee Wah, Subang 1, Century, Moriya) have neither current revenue nor valuation.

HELD-FOR-SALE: 1 Genting Lane, 8 Tuas View Square, 31 Penjuru Lane (Singapore) and Subang 2 (Malaysia) classified as investment properties held for sale. Their agreed values (S$12.3m, S$11.18m, S$7.8m, S$9.48m approx) are NOT in the Portfolio Statement valuation column — those rows show null valuation.
5A JOO KOON CIRCLE REDEVELOPMENT: Zero gross revenue and zero occupancy for FY24/25 (redevelopment in progress); valuation jumped to S$188m from S$55.1m in FY23/24 on completion.

AUSTRALIA CURRENCY: Valuations in the Group Portfolio Statement are presented in SGD equivalent (currency=AUD noted for context but numbers in JSON are SGD translated at closing rate). The Australia Operations Review (p56) reports A$1,119.3m total for 14 properties.

HONG KONG SAR CURRENCY: Valuations in Group Portfolio Statement in SGD; local currency HKD noted. Mapletree Logistics Hub Tsing Yi at S$1,284,062k is the single largest HK property (50-year leasehold).

GROUP vs MLT: The 197-row property list is the GROUP Portfolio Statement (p130-167) which includes all subsidiaries. The MLT (trust entity only) Portfolio Statement (p168-171) shows Singapore properties only (52 rows) with SGD valuations totalling S$2,560,100k. The group-level extraction is the canonical one per schema.

reconciliation.gross_revenue_note: MLT is a multi-currency portfolio. The 73 non-SGD property rows (Australia/Japan/Malaysia/South Korea/Hong Kong) carry local-currency gross revenues; only SGD rows can be directly summed to the consolidated S$727,026k P&L total. The sum_property_gross_revenue and reported_total_gross_revenue above represent the SGD consolidated total from the audited P&L (p121) which is the authoritative figure. Local-currency SGD-only rows (Singapore S$201,149k from MLT p171; Vietnam/India S$ rows) sum to S$365,457k; the remainder is translated from AUD/JPY/MYR/KRW/HKD at average FX rates. Full per-geography breakdown available in Note 29 (p221-224).

income_components_check.gap_note: Small gap due to fx gain netting treatment in other_trust_expenses: the net foreign exchange gain of S$1,480k is recorded as a positive adjustment (reducing expense), while other_trust_expenses_net of S$5,327k is recorded as expense. The reported P&L shows net other trust expenses of S$10,909k = -1,480+674+6,388+5,327=10,909. Reconciliation approaches reported figure within rounding of component-level capture.
